title: El Palo Fierro de Kino, MEXI TV
comment: palofierro-kino (MEXITV): puesto de tallado de palo fierro en la playa de Bahía de Kino, Sonora. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ELISEO_ROBLES: Mexican man from Sonora, wood carver, 70 years old, lean, deeply tanned skin, white hair tied in a short ponytail, a short white beard, a faded light-blue linen shirt, rolled-up cream trousers, leather sandals, his hands empty.
chars.NAYELI_ROBLES: Mexican woman from Sonora, 24 years old, tanned skin, long loose black hair, an open white linen shirt over a coral top, light-blue jeans, white sneakers, her hands empty.
chars.BRAYAN_SOTO: Mexican man, 32 years old, light-brown skin, curly black hair with a fade, a thin mustache, a printed silk shirt with green palm leaves, a gold chain, white trousers, designer sunglasses on his head, his hands empty.
chars.SAUL_SOTO: Mexican man from Sonora, 58 years old, heavy-set, light-brown skin, grey crew cut, a thick grey mustache, a cream straw cowboy hat, a black polo shirt, a gold watch, dark jeans, brown boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_PLAYAKINO: Beach at Bahía de Kino, Sonora, at golden sunset: a small open palm-roof stand on the sand with a wooden table full of polished dark ironwood carvings of dolphins, turtles and eagles, rocky hills with tall saguaro cacti, the calm turquoise Sea of Cortez, a sandy road, warm golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
